'lu-*' cases: every labelled utterance in OverlordBot.Core/Documentation/OverlordBot.lu ('labelled' is the original line) with expected entities extracted from its LUIS labels (sendTransport utterances expect intent None: the original ITransmission.Intents enum has no such intent). 'cs-*' cases: textual equivalents of OverlordBot.Cognitive.Tests/TransmissionParser. 'stt-*' cases are not from OverlordBot: whisper.cpp transcripts measured in artifacts/speech-benchmark.json, with 'expected' taken from the meaning of the spoken 'reference'. Where 'expected' differs from the original label, 'label' keeps the extracted original and 'correction' gives the category, reason and corrected fields. 'known_groups' is passed to parse() as the live unit list. Airfield names are compared after alias resolution with data/vocabulary.json and data/aliases.json. See data/PROVENANCE.md.

correction.reason: the original ParseResponse keeps topIntent radioCheck with UnknownEntity receiver and transmitter; the parser reports intent None for a request addressed to nobody, as the .lu labels the same utterance (lu-None-046). Receiver and transmitter are unknown either way
